moments.title: Commonwealth Games Glasgow 2026 Finale

angles.name: music highlight
angles.copy: Simple Minds headline the Glasgow 2026 closing ceremony on Sunday, August 2nd. A fitting end to a memorable Games!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No. 1
moments.blurb: "Rein Me In" by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean remains at No. 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for its 18th nonconsecutive week, a record for a track not hitting the US Hot 100 top 10.

angles.name: chart domination
angles.copy: Still at the top! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes it an incredible 18 nonconsecutive weeks at UK No. 1.

angles.copy: Can anyone knock Sam Fender & Olivia Dean off the top spot? 'Rein Me In' continues its chart domination and record-breaking run!

angles.name: congrats to artists
angles.copy: Eighteen weeks and counting! Huge congrats to Sam Fender and Olivia Dean on their record-breaking UK No. 1.
